name: A Lover's Curse
source:
A Lover's Curse is an interactive choice-based murder mystery story full of sexy adult scenes and horror themes. This game has multiple endings and scenes that can only be unlocked by certain combinations of choices making this game lots of fun to play multiple times to see all of the hidden scenes and endings available!

Our story is set at a college Halloween birthday party where things take a mysterious turn for the worst. Try to find out what's really going on while fucking your way through all of the sexy ladies available to you in both duo and group activities.

[From [url=https://saucegamestudios.itch.io/a-lovers-curse]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《A Lover's Curse》是一部充满香艳成人场景与恐怖元素的互动选择式谋杀悬疑视觉小说。游戏包含多个结局与特殊场景，唯有通过特定的选项组合才能解锁，非常适合多周目游玩以集齐所有隐藏场景与结局！

故事背景设定在一场大学万圣节生日派对上，事态在那里发生了神秘而险恶的转折。在双人或多人运动中一路睡遍身边所有性感女郎的同时，设法查明这一切背后的真相吧。
